name: Wireframe
author: E. T. Carter
description: A glowing wireframe mesh draped over a real mountain height field, seen from a low camera gliding along a valley toward a lit horizon under a dark sky. The grid follows every fold of the terrain, pinching on steep faces and vanishing behind the ridges it climbs, while a scan pulse rolls away down the lines and a few stars turn overhead. Synthwave register, held back: no banded sun, just lines and haze.

params.label: Glide
params.effect: Speed of the camera glide down the valley and of the scan pulse; 0 holds the terrain still.

params.label: Relief
params.effect: Height of the mountains either side of the valley; 0 flattens the mesh to a rolling plain.

params.label: Grid density
params.effect: Grid lines per world unit; low is a coarse open mesh, high is a fine dense weave.

params.label: Glow
params.effect: Strength of the halo around every line and of the valley haze; 0 is crisp bare lines.

params.label: Valley width
params.effect: Width of the flat floor the camera glides along; 0 puts mountains right under the camera.
